settings.title: A Specialized Builder for Complex Environments

settings.editor:
Our expertise spans cold storage, food processing, industrial, and institutional construction, with experience delivering facilities that involve demanding operational requirements, specialized systems, regulatory considerations, and complex project conditions.

From refrigerated warehouses and CFIA-compliant food processing facilities to industrial operations and institutional spaces, our team brings the expertise needed to deliver projects from planning through completion.
We design and construct specialized industrial and commercial facilities across Canada that support performance, compliance, and long-term operational success.

settings.title: Built for Canadian Food Safety Standards

settings.editor:
Food processing and cold storage facilities require a level of expertise beyond traditional construction.

Glacier West understands the requirements behind CFIA-compliant construction, including hygienic design, food-safe materials, cleanable surfaces, and operational workflows that support inspection readiness.

Our team works closely with clients to design and construct facilities aligned with HACCP principles, GMP standards, and Canadian food safety expectations.

settings.title: A Construction Partner Built for Performance

settings.editor: Strong partnerships drive better projects. We work with clients and project teams to solve challenges and deliver facilities built around their needs.
With over 30 years of experience, we bring construction, engineering, and project management expertise to complex projects across Canada.
Our repeat clients and referrals reflect the trust we've earned through quality, clear communication, and reliable project delivery.

Neil and his team provided exceptional service, communication and commitment in meeting our needs. The team at Glacier West was easy to communicate with, thorough, and performed well throughout the project. They adapted as our needs changed and presented options and experienced input during design planning. The project was delivered on time and met all expectations.

While working with the folks at Glacier West, we built strong relationship with the group. We felt respected through the process, and managed to keep our existing operations ongoing while the renovation was completed. They acted professionally with us, keeping our operations in mind, and treating our team with respect.

During potentially costly construction times, the folks at Glacier were able to adhere to previously fixed price & deliver on their promises. At the end of the project, we made friendships with this group, and look forward to working with them again.

Construction is not a perfect science, we know that. Glacier is not perfect either, and they make mistakes like any firm. When mistakes happen or project issues of varying types come up (which they do), we trust the folks at Glacier West to meet us where we are at and come up with timely and viable solutions that keep the project health, at its priority. We work together, and not against each other. It is a two-way street.
